title: Single representable ind-objects detect bounded-below derived isomorphisms
statement: Let C be a small abelian category and Ind(C) its category of ind-objects, with the convention in [lem-sfb-ind-filtered-colimits]. Choose any derived localization universe for D⁺(Ind(C)), as in [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. For a morphism g:M→N in D⁺(Ind(C)), suppose that for every A in C and n in ℤ postcomposition with g is bijective from Hom(y(A)[-n],M) to Hom(y(A)[-n],N), where y is the ind-Yoneda embedding and y(A)[-n] denotes the single complex in degree n. Then g is invertible. No geometric scheme, constructible realization or Frobenius action is assumed.

source.place: §15.3; step 3 of lem-zl-barrett-ind-realization, bounded-below orthogonality and the cone argument, written out by R5.

proof.text: Representables generate Ind(C): take a filtered presentation of Z; if all maps y(A)→Z vanish then every leg of that colimit cocone vanishes. Colimit extensionality gives id_Z=0, so Z=0.

Suppose Z is bounded below and every map from a single representable in every degree to Z vanishes. Fix a lower bound n. Its truncation τ≤n Z is pure in degree n, hence a single complex on an ind-object H. Maps from a single representable to this truncation inject into maps to Z by t-structure orthogonality. Full faithfulness of the single functor makes all maps y(A)→H zero. Step 1 gives H=0. Thus τ≤n Z=0, which raises the lower bound to n+1. Induction raises the bound arbitrarily; each cohomology object is zero and Z=0.

Complete g to a distinguished triangle. Apply Hom from each single representable and from its shifts. Bijectivity for g and its shifted Hom maps makes all maps from each test object to the cone vanish, by the long exact Hom sequence. The cone is bounded below; step 2 makes it zero. The distinguished-triangle criterion gives that g is invertible.

proof_origin.place: R5 complete Lean proof: filtered-presentation generation, pure truncation, induction on lower bounds, shift full faithfulness, and distinguished-cone exactness. No sorry.

theorem CategoryTheory.indDerived_singleYoneda_detects_iso
    (C : Type u) [SmallCategory C] [Abelian C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Ind C)]
    {M N : DerivedCategory.Plus (Ind C)} (g : M ⟶ N)
    (hg : ∀ (A : C) (n : ℤ), Function.Bijective
      (fun h : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor (Ind C) n).obj
        (Ind.yoneda.obj A) ⟶ M ↦ h ≫ g)) : IsIso g
